strings: r_c0 winces at the whimpers and shudders that m_c is doing. {PRONOUN/r_c0/subject/CAP} {VERB/r_c0/know/knows} that m_c is in a lot of pain and {VERB/r_c0/are/is} only able to do so much with the herbs that {PRONOUN/r_c0/subject} {VERB/r_c0/have/has}.

m_c whimpers, {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} whole body shaking as {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/try/tries} to take the herbs given to {PRONOUN/m_c/object}. It's hard when the world spins and swims from all the pain.
A lot of m_c's Clanmates are worried about {PRONOUN/m_c/object} due to how m_c refuses to move from the sheer pain of it.
Simply brushing up against someone makes m_c wince and let out little yowls of pain.
m_c is curled up in {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} nest shaking, unable to move without letting out cries of pain.
